title: New models for research, code, and chat
summary:
Two alpha community models and Sonnet 4.6 joined the lineup, while the app catalog grew and Polly learned to draw charts.

Two alpha community text models were added: `nomnom` for web research and `polly` for work with GitHub, code search, the web, and code execution. The paid `claude` model was upgraded from Sonnet 4.5 to Sonnet 4.6, with `claude-sonnet-4.6` added to the registry.

Five community apps joined the catalog, spanning video editing, chat, an Apple-device assistant, Colombian legal drafting, and Big-O analysis. Submission guidelines now spell out what a useful, reviewable app needs. The README showcase and news were also refreshed; the App Greenhouse count now reads 548.

Text message normalization now preserves null content in tool calls, along with function-call, cache-control, reasoning, and audio fields. It also stops clamping `repetition_penalty` to 0–2. Separately, `oh-my-pollicode` received simpler installer messaging, updated key guidance, and a package version bump to 2.0.0.

highlights.title: NomNom researches the web
highlights.text: Use the alpha `nomnom` text model for research with search, scraping, and crawling. [Browse NomNom](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nomnom).

highlights.title: Polly joins the models
highlights.text: The alpha `polly` model accepts text and images and can use GitHub, code-search, web, and code-execution tools. [Browse Polly](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=polly).

highlights.title: Claude moves to Sonnet 4.6
highlights.text: The paid `claude` model now uses Sonnet 4.6. The registry also accepts `claude-sonnet-4.6`, while `claude-sonnet` remains an alias. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-sonnet-4.6).

highlights.title: Polly draws the data
highlights.text: Ask Polly for a data visualization in Discord and it can render the result as an image in its reply.

highlights.title: Polly explores more GitHub
highlights.text: Polly can retrieve GitHub data beyond its previous REST path list, including through read-only GraphQL queries.
